topic: GST jumped *23%* in October to ₹2.31 lak
hook: GST jumped *23%* in October to ₹2.31 lakh crore
hook_b: Imports, not shopping, drove October's GST? Import tax up *42%*
tldr: Gross GST hit ₹2.31 lakh crore in October, up 23%; net collections rose 26% to ₹2.03 lakh crore.

beats.what: Government data on Nov 1 showed gross GST of over ₹2.31 lakh crore for October.
beats.why: Domestic sales GST rose 16% to ₹1.59 lakh crore; import GST jumped 42% to ₹72,246 crore.
beats.care: GST is in every bill you pay. Higher collections give the Centre and states more to spend.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Split: Central GST ₹42,935 crore, State GST ₹51,340 crore, Integrated GST over ₹1.37 lakh crore. Refunds rose 6.5% to ₹27,934 crore. Net of refunds, collections rose 26% to over ₹2.03 lakh crore. April–October gross GST grew 13.2% to ₹14.77 lakh crore. The report did not give state-wise or Telangana figures.

cards.title: 🔢 Year so far
cards.body: April–October: gross ₹14.77 lakh crore (+13.2%), net ₹12.69 lakh crore (+13%).

cards.q: GST collections are up. What should it fund?
Which part of GST grew fastest in October?
cards.why: Revenue from imports climbed 42% to ₹72,246 crore; domestic sales GST rose 16%.

insight: Import GST rose 42% while GST on domestic sales rose 16%.
watch: November's figure, and whether import-led growth lasts.
